items.title: Damaged highways disrupt Dashain travel, airlines prepare late-night flights
items.blurb: With over a million people expected to leave Kathmandu Valley by road, the collapse of a section of the Prithvi Highway has stranded travellers and forced authorities to expand transport arrangements.

items.title: Selective buying offers little lift to Nepse as turnover declines
items.blurb: Banking shares gained, and hydropower stocks dominated trading, but weak turnover and losses across most sectors point to limited investor confidence.

items.title: Bhotekoshi floods leave 269 children without one or both parents
items.blurb: A study of 584 children living in holding centres in Kathmandu, Nuwakot and Rasuwa finds that 41 had lost both parents, 161 their fathers and 67 their mothers.

items.title: Storms and heavy rain devastate crops across western Nepal
items.blurb: Farmers in Kailali, Bardiya, Salyan and Dang have suffered losses to paddy, fruits, and vegetables, raising fears of lower yields and increasing demands for government relief.

items.title: Thousands of flood-displaced children remain out of reach of measles vaccination
items.blurb: Health officials have indefinitely stalled vaccination in three flood-hit districts, warning that displaced children face a heightened risk of infectious disease outbreaks.

items.title: Inside the deadlock at the world’s top climate science body
items.blurb: The UN Environment Programme has said repeatedly that global efforts to limit warming are falling short and that faster emissions cuts are needed to avoid more extreme weather and climate-related disasters.

items.title: Road subsidence halts traffic on Prithvi Highway near Gajuri
items.blurb: A nearly 100-metre stretch of road has developed cracks, while a 20-metre section has subsided, raising fears of further damage and landslides.
